name: AZ US Archived Orders - Find Product by ASIN

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: testOrder: put one order number (e.g. S23346) to fix only that order. Leave empty for all.

filter.value: ={{ $('Get AZ US New Orders').all().map(i => i.json).filter(o => o.has_archived_products && (!$('Config').first().json.testOrder || o.name === $('Config').first().json.testOrder.trim().toUpperCase())).map(o => o.id) }}
={{ [...new Set($('Lines of Archived Orders').all().flatMap(i => [i.json.asin, i.json.amazon_asin]).filter(a => a && String(a).trim()).map(a => String(a).trim()))] }}
={{ [...new Set($('Lines of Archived Orders').all().flatMap(i => [i.json.asin, i.json.amazon_asin]).filter(a => a && String(a).trim()).map(a => String(a).trim()))] }}

={{ [...new Set([...$('Orders with same ASIN (field 1)').all(), ...$('Orders with same ASIN (field 2)').all()].map(i => i.json).filter(l => l.id).map(l => l.product_id && l.product_id[0]).filter(Boolean))] }}

={{ [...new Set([...$('Orders with same ASIN (field 1)').all(), ...$('Orders with same ASIN (field 2)').all()].map(i => i.json).filter(l => l.id).map(l => l.product_template_id && l.product_template_id[0]).filter(Boolean))] }}

nodes.name: Plan (find product by ASIN)
nodes.notes: For each archived line: find another order with the same ASIN (field 1, then field 2) that has a real product, take that product, pick the size from the SKU.

nodes.name: Replace Product on Line
nodes.notes: Keeps the original price, description and taxes; only the product changes
